method: one separate text-only native generation per asset
notes: All 11 output PNGs were visually inspected and checked using read-only metadata/alpha analysis.
Merchant is native 1254×1254 RGBA with genuine alpha transparency. Its bbox uses alpha>=128 and exclusive right/bottom edges.
All ten backgrounds are native 1672×941 RGB, fully opaque, approximately 16:9 (aspect 1.7768331562). Exact requested 1536×864 was not produced.
All backgrounds have empty left/right actor positions at about 75% image height. Floor depth varies between rooms; supplied floor bands are visual estimates, not generated masks.
No output bitmap was resized, cropped, redrawn, cleaned or otherwise programmatically edited.
No retry was needed. All original native files remain outside the repository.

assets.prompt:
Create one original full-body idle merchant sprite for the whimsical sinister office-stationery cellar roguelike “Дворец слов — подвал”.
An odd friendly elderly itinerant junk dealer in a patched dusty-olive coat, large cream moustache, round spectacles, tattered soft hat, an orange/copper scarf, and a bag of unlabelled wares slung over his shoulder. He holds one small coin in one hand and a little closed ledger with a blank cover in the other. No writing anywhere.
Exactly one complete figure, facing RIGHT in a three-quarter view. One idle pose only. Square canvas, centered with generous transparent padding, entire hat, bag, hands and feet inside the central 75% of the canvas.
Deliberately chunky LOW-RESOLUTION pixel art, approximately 72 logical pixels across the entire figure, enlarged with nearest-neighbor hard square pixels. Thick very dark brown/black staircase outlines, large connected flat color clusters, 3–5 discrete shades per material. Muted warm cellar palette: cream, ochre, dusty olive and copper. Friendly eccentric expression, readable silhouette. Original character, no copyrighted likenesses.
Output PNG with REAL RGBA transparency. All empty space outside and within the silhouette must be truly transparent. No drawn checkerboard, no background color, no floor, no shadow, no glow, no halo, no scene, no UI, no text, no letters, no labels, no watermark or frame. No photorealism, smooth vector curves, painterly noise, gradients or fine stippling. Only the isolated merchant.

Create one original EMPTY ROOM BACKGROUND for the side-on 2D battle stages in the pixel-art cellar roguelike “Дворец слов — подвал”.
Room design: The entrance to an old stone cellar. Descending stairs tucked into the back-left wall, a broad worn stone arch in the back center, two amber lanterns fixed to the masonry, a few small dusty wooden remnants near the back wall. Inviting but mysterious first room.
Canvas: WIDE LANDSCAPE 16:9, ideally 1536×864. Fill the entire canvas with a fully OPAQUE painted environment. This is a background image, not a transparent sprite.
Camera and layout: side-on 2D battle-stage view, nearly straight-on to the back wall, mild architectural depth only. NOT top-down and NOT isometric. Architecture and props occupy the upper TWO THIRDS. The bottom THIRD is a broad continuous FLAT horizontal walkable stone floor, brighter and simpler than the back wall. The intended actor standing baseline is exactly around 75% of image height. Leave broad unoccupied actor positions on BOTH the left and right sides around that baseline. Keep all furniture, machinery, stairs, fire, crates and detail close to the BACK WALL, behind the play lane. No foreground obstruction, no central pit, no steps across the battle lane. The same camera height and floor arrangement should suit every room in the series.
Art direction: original deliberately LOW-RESOLUTION chunky pixel art, imagined visual grid of 256×144 pixels or fewer, enlarged with nearest-neighbor square pixels. Large hard square color clusters, thick black/dark-brown staircase outlines, flat limited color palette, sparse meaningful details. Minimal fine texture, no dithering or stippled noise, no smooth gradients, no soft photorealistic lighting. Warm sepia cellar palette with cream, ochre, dusty olive and copper; tasteful restrained red/teal/purple accents appropriate to this room. Atmospheric depth expressed through large discrete flat shade bands. Brighter readable foreground ground, strong clear stage silhouettes, uncluttered composition.
Absolute exclusions: NO CHARACTERS, NO PEOPLE, NO VENDORS, NO CREATURES, NO FACES, NO STATUES, NO LETTERS, NO TEXT, NO NUMBERS, NO SIGNS, NO LABELS, NO UI, NO LOGOS OR WATERMARKS, no interface border. No copyrighted characters or copied game assets. No photorealism, smooth vector art, painterly rendering, noisy texture or blur. Only the fully opaque empty pixel-art environment.
